faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: The disappearance of Michigan businesswoman Dee Warner led to a multi-year murder…
kurzfassung: When successful businesswoman Dee Warner vanished from her Michigan farm in 2021, her family immediately suspected her husband, Dale Warner. Despite the absence of a body, investigators meticulously pieced together circumstantial evidence, leading to a major breakthrough when her remains were discovered inside an agricultural tank years later. Dale was ultimately convicted of second-degree murder and tampering with evidence, bringing long-awaited closure to her grieving family.
stichpunkte: Dee Warner vanished from her Michigan farm in April 2021, leaving behind her vehicles and phones.
Her husband Dale claimed she left voluntarily after an argument, but family members immediately suspected foul play.
Investigators and family members searched thousands of acres of farmland using drones, dogs, and foot searches.
Police scrutinized various acquaintances, including an employee named Todd, but ultimately ruled them out.
Private investigators and grassroots campaigns kept public pressure on authorities to solve the case.
State police took over the investigation and focused heavily on circumstantial evidence pointing to Dale.
Authorities finally located Dee's remains hidden inside a welded fertilizer tank on the property.
Dale Warner was found guilty of second-degree murder and evidence tampering, receiving up to 70 years in prison.

clips.text: Relatives emphasize that the missing woman never walked anywhere and always drove, making the discovery of her vehicles parked at the property highly suspicious.
The husband produced an expensive wedding ring that was left on a desk, which authorities found inconsistent with a voluntary departure.

clips.hook: Only two people on the property
clips.text: Investigators map out the timeline and realize that only the husband and a specific employee were on the farm around the time of the disappearance.
During a police interrogation, the husband defiantly insists that his wife is still alive and merely watching and laughing at everyone.
Law enforcement personnel witness the exact moment an X-ray scan of a sealed metal container reveals the hidden remains.

beschreibung:
When a beloved mother and businesswoman vanishes, her family begins their own investigation and public campaign against the man they suspect is responsible.
